senses.gloss:
soḍhaukikā (etym. not clear), an attitude disapproved^1 for monks on the begging round: Mvy 〔8553〕 na soḍhaukikayā; Tib. phrag pa mi sprad, shoulders not brought together; Chin. shoulders not raised or not shaken; Jap. = Tib. Not in Pali (Vin. 〔iv.187—189〕).
[1] Correction submitted by on 20210831. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/80.
